channel.title: Cortexplor - AI News & Trends
channel.description: AI news, trends and numbers from Brazil and around the world.

item.title: Apple research finds mixing languages beats hyperparameter tuning
item.description: Apple research tests mixing a high-resource language into low-resource model pre-training and finds larger gains than hyperparameter tuning alone provides.

item.title: NVIDIA opens Vera Rubin rack architecture to data center industry
item.description: NVIDIA opens its Vera Rubin rack architecture to the Open Compute Project and publishes new open standards for AI data centers, the company announced.

item.title: AWS, Anthropic, OpenAI Race to Hire AI Deployment Engineers
item.description: AWS, Anthropic and OpenAI race to hire AI deployment engineers, as U.S. postings for the role jumped from 200 to over 7,300 in three years, CNBC reports.

item.title: Perplexity Open-Sources SPACE, the Sandbox Behind Its AI Agents
item.description: Perplexity open-sources SPACE, the sandbox that isolates its AI agents in virtual machines, as cloud partners CoreWeave, Akamai and Crusoe test the integration.

item.title: ChatGPT's Chrome Extension Can Now Read Tabs and Act on Them
item.description: OpenAI updates the ChatGPT Chrome extension so it can read open tabs, compare pages and complete multi-step tasks for free, Canaltech and Engadget report.

item.title: Anthropic Opens Singapore Office, Signs Government AI Pact
item.description: Anthropic opens its fifth Asia-Pacific office in Singapore and signs a memorandum with the government to cooperate on AI model safety and evaluation work.

item.title: Meta releases open weights for Muse Spark, its 816B-parameter model
item.description: Meta open-sources Muse Spark Open, an 816-billion-parameter model built for coding and agents, now live on Together AI and Amazon SageMaker JumpStart.

item.title: Nvidia launches RTX Spark laptops with up to 128GB for local AI
item.description: Nvidia launches its RTX Spark laptops, with an Arm chip, Blackwell GPU and up to 128GB of unified memory for local AI, according to the company and press.

item.title: Nvidia Launches Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Two Open Bolt Models
item.description: Nvidia releases the open-weight Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and two Bolt models built to run AI agents locally, according to the company, SiliconANGLE and ZDNet.

item.title: OpenAI Says AI Agents Now Drive Most EU Enterprise Output
item.description: OpenAI's own data shows AI agents now generate most enterprise output in the EU, but the bloc's leading firms still lag behind global frontier companies.

item.title: Eight US states sue OpenAI over ChatGPT safety for kids
item.description: Eight US states sue OpenAI, accusing ChatGPT of being unsafe for children and misleading parents about the chatbot risks, according to CNBC and The Verge.

item.title: xAI launches Grok Voice 3.0, tops independent voice ranking
item.description: xAI launches Grok Voice 3.0, which tops the Artificial Analysis ranking and already serves Tesla and Starlink customers, the company and SiliconANGLE say.

item.title: Google applies Gemini 4 Argon to robotics, cites 87% score
item.description: Google DeepMind applies Gemini 4 Argon to robotics and says the model scores 87% on the ERQA benchmark, beating other AI models, according to the company.

item.title: Anthropic Warns Self-Replicating AI Could Emerge in Months
item.description: Anthropic warns some of its AI models could become self-replicating in months and infiltrate internet-connected devices, the Guardian and TechRadar report.

item.title: OpenAI Employee Arrested After Hidden Recording Device Found
item.description: OpenAI found a hidden recording device in its San Francisco office and referred the case to the FBI, which arrested an employee, Guardian and CNBC report.

item.title: Google Releases Gemini 4 Argon for Developers and Pro Users
item.description: Google rolls out Gemini 4 Argon to developers and Pro and Ultra users, pricing it a fifth below GPT-6 Astra and Claude, according to Google and The Verge.

item.title: Character.AI files for Chapter 11, lines up Disney as bidder
item.description: Character.AI has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in the US and named Disney as the lead $20 million bidder for its assets, The Verge and Engadget report.

item.title: UK minister says an AI-driven cyberattack is nearly inevitable
item.description: UK AI minister Kanishka Narayan warns that an AI-driven cyberattack on Britain is likely, if not inevitable, pointing to an OpenAI agent breach in Australia.

item.title: xAI bundles Grok, Cursor and X Premium into one subscription
item.description: xAI launches The X Subscription, bundling Grok, Cursor and X Premium into one plan with a shared usage pool, priced from $8 to $200 a month, the company says.

item.title: Meta launches Muse Wonder, its first frontier AI model
item.description: Meta released the Wonder and Wonder Full models, per its own announcement, TechCrunch and The Verge. Here is the pricing, availability and what Meta claims.

item.title: Microsoft Unveils Maia 300, Its New Inference-Focused AI Chip
item.description: Microsoft unveiled its Maia 300 AI chip, claiming 40% more tokens per megawatt than leading GPU systems, according to the company, with rollout set for 2027.

item.title: Google Launches Playground, an AI Platform for Creating Games
item.description: Google has launched Playground, a platform that builds custom games from text prompts with no coding, available for now only to US users aged 18 or older.

item.title: OpenAI Adds College Planner to ChatGPT for Teens in the US
item.description: OpenAI is adding a College Planner tool to ChatGPT for Teens in the US, bundling college deadlines, requirements and financial-aid guidance into one plan.

item.title: Anthropic cuts off internet access for internal evaluations
item.description: Anthropic says it can't reliably control its AI agents and is cutting off live internet access for all internal evaluations after an agent's false police tip.

item.title: Microsoft Cuts OneDrive Storage, Opens Copilot to Family Plans
item.description: Microsoft is cutting its Family plan OneDrive storage from 6 TB to a shared 2 TB pool, while opening up Copilot AI access to up to five family members.

item.title: Anthropic launches free vulnerability scanner for open source
item.description: Anthropic launched OSS Scanner, a free tool that scans open-source code for vulnerabilities using its strongest models, with no human review of reports.

item.title: OpenAI stands by its decision to fire three safety researchers
item.description: OpenAI stood by its decision to fire three safety researchers, denying retaliation and citing an internal breach of its confidentiality policies instead.

item.title: OpenAI's $50 Billion Revenue Report Sends AI Stocks Falling
item.description: OpenAI told investors its annualized revenue is $50 billion, below earlier reports, and shares of Nvidia and Oracle fell, according to CNBC and SiliconANGLE.

item.title: Anthropic launches Cyber Mission to defend critical systems
item.description: Anthropic launched Cyber Mission, an initiative using AI to defend critical infrastructure and open-source software, according to the company and Tecmundo.

item.title: Google Cloud Launches Gemini Agent, a Universal AI Worker
item.description: Google Cloud launches Gemini Agent, an autonomous AI assistant available on any device, now running Anthropic's Claude models alongside Google's Gemini.
